== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Started playing from Season 1
* First Player from the Czech Republic to play at Worlds.
* First Player with [[Carzzy]] from the Czech Republic to win the LEC title.
* First Player in [[LEC]] to qualify to three consecutive [[World_Championship|World Championships]] from other teams than [[G2 Esports]] or [[Fnatic]].
* Reached 1000 kills in the LEC on January 14, 2024.
** The 13th player to reach 1000 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]], [[Jankos]], [[Perkz]], [[nukeduck]], [[Caps]], [[Wunder]], [[Kobbe]], [[Hans sama]], [[Odoamne]], [[Upset]], [[Larssen]], and [[Carzzy]].
* Prefers to play AP Casters and Assasins.
* During his tenure at [[FNATIC]] he built himself a reputation in the [[LEC]] for ramping up over the year while playing loose in the regular season.					
* Got his first regular season 1st place in [[LEC 2024 Spring]] Split with a 6-3 scoreline after over 5 years of competition.
* He is the face of the 'Absolute Cinema' meme in the LEC.
* Is one of the four players to appear in the [[Worlds 2022]] [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HYsz1hP0BFo anthem].

=== Individual Awards ===
* 4x EU All-Pro 2nd Team (Summer 2019, Summer 2021, Spring 2022, Summer 2023)
* 2x EU All-Pro 3rd Team (Summer 2020, Spring 2021)
